children: Build-to-order is making up more of KB Home's business, executives tell analysts on a call. The build-to-order model has allowed the company to sell before it builds and know costs before committing capital, which has been especially important amid a stagnant housing market. Build-to-order homes represented nearly three quarters of KB Home's deliveries in the latest quarter, which executives say helped margins. KB Home currently has about 1,100 homes sold but not yet started, and direct costs on started homes were lower in the latest quarter. (katherine.hamilton@wsj.com)
